title: Batch scheme for ordinary Vanguard troopers
summary: A reusable batch workflow for the ordinary squad members. It is not written for any one sculpt and no exact subject is claimed.

target.description: Any ordinary infantry member of an Example Miniatures Vanguard squad - 32mm plastic

steps.title: Batch basecoat
steps.instruction: Spray all ten bodies Deep Navy on the sprue and let them cure overnight.

steps.title: Weapons
steps.instruction: Block every weapon casing in Gun Grey; do not vary it between models.

org.brushcodex.subject:identity.qualifier: any of the nine ordinary bodies; the workflow does not depend on which

org.brushcodex.product:sourceContext.note: The SAME SKU as the sergeant workflow, and a different painted subject. This is the pair that falsifies SKU-as-subject-key.
